title: Scraper Wizard Start Permission Consistency

items.action: immediately start the created scraper operation

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing operation create and execute permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Existing CreateOperationUseCase and immediate StartOperationUseCase authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing operation create/start audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: Read/navigation access remains independent from starting the scraper operation.

route_guard.reason: The focused change protects the final mutation boundary and affordance.

notes: ScraperOperationWizardPage creates a scraper operation with start_immediately=true. The frontend now requires both fair_crm.operations.create and fair_crm.operations.execute, fails closed in submit(), and hides the final start affordance without both capabilities.
